supplement.what: Chapters XIII (ffx2-trema) and XVII (sin-fins-core) lost every seed 1-4 under the intended strategy at skip speed, so their results screen never played a victory cue. Re-run on the same build with PYREFLY_PROOF_ONLY and seeds 5-16: every attempt again ended in defeat or escape. The results cue is not reachable by the automated strategy in these two chapters; it is the same file (victory-ffx2, victory-ffx) that played at results in 14 other chapters, and tools/audio/themes-audit.mjs checks their music.victory wiring.
